title: Deterministic shard-led block-arena with pin-fence and prefetch coalescer
author: Asha Patel
body: Motivation: Under high-concurrency continuous-batching workloads we observed cross-tenant and cross-shard KV churn where frequent eviction/rehydration of adjacent slots increased tail latency and token cost. This PR implements a deterministic, shard-led block-arena allocator that groups hot slots by spatial affinity, a tenant-aware pin-fence to avoid accidental cross-tenant displacement, and a lightweight prefetch coalescer that turns small parallel prefetches into batched kernel-friendly reads. Summary of changes: 1) block_arena: new deterministic shard assignment algorithm that maps allocations to stable arenas based on high bits of the key fingerprint; arenas maintain hotlists and soft-fences so frequently accessed blocks remain local to the serving thread pool. 2) pin_fence: per-tenant pin metadata that prevents eviction of tenant-owned hot segments when adjacent non-tenant activity spikes; supports lease-style temporary pins to allow short-lived rebalancing. 3) prefetch_coalescer: introduces a tiny coalescing window (configurable) that aggregates near-simultaneous prefetches into a single IO/kernel call and emits a combined KV load, reducing kernel launch overhead on small workloads. 4) scheduler hints: the runtime scheduler exposes an API so arena ownership can be respected during request routing, reducing cross-arena hot-migrations. Compatibility and safety: default behavior is conservative and controlled via runtime flags (arena.enabled, pin_fence.enabled, prefetch.coalesce_ms). No on-disk format changes. Rollout plan: feature gates start disabled for Dedicated tenants, enabled for a small internal canary cohort, and then gradually rolled out to 25% of traffic for 48 hours before global enable. Benchmarks: end-to-end continuous-batching workload (20 concurrent clients, 1k tokens avg) shows: - 42% reduction in eviction-induced cache misses - 12% median latency improvement and 7% p95 improvement - 18% higher throughput for small-io workloads due to coalesced prefetching Tests: unit tests for arena allocation and fence semantics, integration test that runs mixed-tenant workload and asserts no cross-tenant evictions, fuzzing harness updated for allocator invariants, and e2e perf test in benchmark-lab. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-8142) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Benchmarks run and recorded - [x] Feature gating and telemetry added - [x] Docs updated (runtime/arena.md) Security: pin_fence metadata is only accessible to allocator internals and audited via existing KMS/audit hooks. Related work: this complements prior work on deferred pinning and soft-residency by providing deterministic placement to reduce noisy neighbor effects. Impact: expected to reduce token spend for multitenant workloads with high hot-key skew and make tail latency more predictable. Follow-ups: auto-reshard utility (ENG-8219) to rebalance arenas when skew changes over days.
commits: a7f4e2c: introduce shard-led arena type and tests
b1d2f90: add tenant pin_fence and lease semantics
c93ea41: prefetch coalescer and kernel read batching
d02b11a: expose scheduler hints and runtime flags
review_comments: Liam Chen: Overall looks good. Two requests: ensure that arena assignment is stable across restarts (persist mapping or use deterministic fingerprint) and add a guardrail to avoid creating too many arenas for low-memory hosts.

Asha Patel (author): Reply: arena assignment uses high bits of key fingerprint and the arena count is a cluster-level config; added a fallback to modulo-based assignment when persistent mapping is disabled. Added tests for restart determinism.

Maya Rodriguez: Can we quantify CPU overhead for the pin_fence metadata checks on the hot path? Also request a benchmark for the prefetch coalescer margin where coalescing harms latency for ultra-low-latency requests.
Asha Patel: Added microbench for pin checks; overhead measured <0.6% on median CPU for hot path. Added adaptive backoff so coalescer is a no-op when request latency budget < 2ms.
Oliver Park: CI flake on allocator unit tests — looks like a race in the test harness. Marked a test as flaky and added retry in CI pipeline. Approving after fix.
CI Bot: All checks passed on final run (build/tests/lint). Perf runs uploaded to benchmark-lab.
release_notes: Introduce shard-led block arena, tenant pin-fence, and prefetch coalescer to reduce KV eviction churn and improve latency/throughput for skewed multitenant workloads. Feature gated; disabled by default for Dedicated tenants. See runtime/arena.md for config and rollout instructions.
notes_for_operations: If enabling on a Dedicated cluster, monitor arena_hot_migrations, pin_fence_rejections, and prefetch_coalesce_rate. Revert by disabling arena.enabled and pin_fence.enabled flags. Autoscaler rules should account for reduced eviction churn to avoid overprovisioning during rollouts.
